cb04299a7e43793ad4a898ba7e46f4bc3163c4c0.summary: Appgate Labs analysed a new ransomware family called Egregor, which the report says seems to be a spin-off of Sekhmet. The group reportedly steals data, encrypts files, and threatens to leak data. The sample uses anti-analysis measures. A deep web leak site listed at least 13 companies, including logistics firm GEFCO, which the report says was attacked the week before.

cb17cfd4d3c6aa3d991a3d61cbaf8ceb9586447a.summary: ReliaQuest Threat Research Team report (5 June 2025) on Scattered Spider, a financially motivated group that uses phishing, vishing and help-desk impersonation, with Evilginx to bypass MFA. The report says 81% of a 600-plus domain dataset impersonated technology vendors, and that the group targets managed service providers and IT contractors for one-to-many access, including in partnership with DragonForce ransomware. It links recent UK and US retail breaches to the group only tentatively. It also describes Russia-aligned groups recruiting English-speaking social engineers.

hedges: While nothing definitive has tied these incidents to Scattered Spider, their coordinated nature hints at a broader, orchestrated campaign.
The link between TCS and these breaches remains unclear while the incidents are still under investigation.
The TCS account compromise is attributed to investigators described as allegedly working closely with Marks & Spencer.
It is highly likely, per the report, that Scattered Spider has compromised finance or retail trade organizations that have not yet publicly reported an incident.
The report predicts with high confidence that the group will stay focused on technology, finance and retail trade, and anticipates deepfake voice use, which is not yet observed.
The $10,000-$25,000 monthly earnings for social engineers are stated as reported, not verified.
Domain figures come from over 600 publicly shared indicators and internal digital risk alerts.
The UNC3944 and Octo Tempest aliases are given in the report as names used by other reporting.
